resources.string: This password encrypts everything you put in TrueVault. Choose something you will still remember in a year.
At least 8 characters. A few ordinary words work better than one clever one.
The two passwords do not match.
The vault could not be created on this device. Nothing was saved.
There is no way to reset this
TrueVault cannot recover your local vault without your password or recovery key. There is no account, no email reset, and no support route back in.
TrueVault will store a second, biometric-protected copy of your vault key.
Your fingerprint or face unlocks a key held in this device\'s secure hardware. Your password still works, and still decides.
No fingerprint or face is set up on this device yet. You can add one in system settings and turn this on later.
Biometric hardware is not responding right now. You can turn this on later from Settings.
This device has no strong biometric hardware, so TrueVault will use your password only.
Biometric unlock is not available right now.
Three or four unrelated words are stronger and easier to remember.
This is one of the most commonly guessed passwords.
Mixing letters, numbers or symbols would help at this length.
Enter your vault password to continue.
That password did not open the vault.
Use your fingerprint or face to open your vault.
Your biometrics changed on this device, so the shortcut was switched off. Unlock with your password to set it up again.
This vault was created by a newer version of TrueVault and cannot be opened by this build.
The stored vault key could not be read. Restore from an encrypted backup to continue.
When TrueVault should lock after you leave it.
Lock when the screen turns off
Locks straight away when your screen goes dark, even if TrueVault is still open.
Stops screenshots and screen recording inside TrueVault, and blanks the app in the recent-apps switcher.
Your fingerprint or face opens a key held in secure hardware. Your password always still works.
Keys are held in secure hardware
This device stores your vault key inside hardware that TrueVault cannot read or copy out. Even a full copy of the app\'s files cannot be attacked on another machine.
Keys are protected in software on this device

This device has no secure element available to TrueVault, so your vault key is protected by Android\'s software keystore. Your files are still encrypted, but the protection is weaker than on hardware-backed devices.
Six groups of four characters. Dashes, spaces and letter case do not matter.
